title: Bare Bones x Spiderbat
description: Retextures 4 of Spiderbat's resource packs for Bare Bones
body:
This pack retextures 4 of [Spiderbat's](https://modrinth.com/user/spiderbat) resource packs for Bare Bones. 

The packs are:

- [Reeds](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reeds)
- [Hanging Vines](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hanging-vines)
- [Leaf Decay](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/leaf-decay)
- [Pixel Consistent Signs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/new-signs)

You should not need all 4 packs for this one to work, but they're all cool, so you may as well download them.

### Dependencies:

- [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) - for Pixel Consistent Signs
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) - for Reeds and Hanging Vines

For Leaf Decay, I designed it for use with [Bare Bones - Better Leaves.](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-better-leaves/gallery)
